verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a self-serve export of contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, or the suppression list in an open format. The contact API is described only as import, update, and organize. The only export mentioned covers 7 days of raw transactional events, a different capability from exporting the audience. Data sync connectors and SFTP describe syncing data with other systems, not an audience export.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve
